en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural hillside with scattered villas and summer houses around the Tettye plateau, with trees, fenced fields, and a few flagpoles. The front caption in Hungarian reads "Nyaralók a tettyei fennsík körül." The reverse side has printed Hungarian text describing the place, space for correspondence and address, handwritten German and Hungarian messages, and a green Hungarian postage stamp with a postmark.
